<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula: DBE = (2C + 2 - H)/2 (no N or halogens, O ignored). For C15H15O5, DBE = (2*15 + 2 - 15)/2 = 17/2 = 8.5, which suggests a likely typo in the hydrogen count. Assuming the intended neutral formula is C15H14O5, DBE = (30 + 2 - 14)/2 = 18/2 = 9, an integer value.</thought>
<final_answer>9</final_answer>
